177:t_1:249.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you can keep up with the way 《$$グローリー・スター$$》 does things.」

177:t_1:251.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It's the team I used to belong to... And it's my pride, too.」

177:t_1:252.en:
$n
「Please, $$セツコ$$. I'll stake my own pride on this, too.」

177:t_1:253.en:
$$ランド$$
「If that's settled, let's get right into special training! I can at least play your sparring partner.」

177:t_1:254.en:
$n
「Sorry, since I'm the one who brought it up, but I have something to do after this...」

177:t_1:256.en:
$n
「$$アルト$$'s been tormented by nightmares for a while now. He's resting even now.」

177:t_1:257.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Now that you mention it, he isn't in the hangar...」

177:t_1:258.en:
$n
「I'm going to go check on him. It's not like I can do anything, though...」

177:t_1:259.en:
$$セツコ$$
「All right, $n. Once that's settled, let's start your training.」

177:t_1:261.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...He really cares about his friends, doesn't he.」

177:t_1:262.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes... For him, having lost his family, his comrades in $c are irreplaceable.」

177:t_1:263.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Still, $$アルト$$... What on earth is going on with him...)

177:t_1:266.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sorry. I spoke to you so suddenly, and I startled you.」

177:t_1:268.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You don't have to be nervous. I'm not after your $$スフィア$$.」

177:t_1:270.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Let me introduce myself properly. I'm $$セツコ・オハラ$$...」

177:t_1:271.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Just as you sensed, I'm the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$悲しみの乙女$$.」

177:t_1:273.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I heard about $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. I'm sorry.」

177:t_1:274.en:
$n
「So you know $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ too, $$セツコ$$.」

177:t_1:275.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... On $$翠の地球$$, I was fighting alongside him.」

177:t_1:276.en:
$$セツコ$$
(He said... that the $$いがみ合う双子$$, the twin Reactors, would save us...)

177:t_1:277.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I don't know what those words mean... But I want to believe him...)

177:t_1:279.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...May I call you $n, like everyone else does?」

177:t_1:281.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Don't be so nervous. I may be a little older, but we're not that far apart in age.」

177:t_1:283.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're a boy after all, $n. The moment you see a beautiful woman, you get like this.」

177:t_1:285.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's no use hiding it. I've thought for a while that you have a weakness for older women, $n.」

177:t_1:288.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Heh... I thought he'd be more sensitive, but he's a surprisingly ordinary kid, isn't he?」

177:t_1:289.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Not at all. He may look like any ordinary high schooler now, but until not long ago he was like a bare blade...」

177:t_1:290.en:
$$スズネ$$
「He'd decided that adults never understand anything, and he hurt everyone who came near him.」

177:t_1:293.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But after meeting everyone in $c, he changed before my eyes, and the puny little boy he was has now become a full-fledged...」

177:t_1:294.en:
$n
「W-wait a minute, Miss $$スズネ$$! What do you have against me!?」

177:t_1:297.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you think you can just be handed every answer like that, you're sorely mistaken. Think for yourself a little.」

177:t_1:298.en:
$n
(I think I just flipped some bad switch...)

177:t_1:299.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Heh... Miss $$スズネ$$ really is a teacher, isn't she.」

177:t_1:302.en:
$n
「There's something I'd like you to teach me too, $$セツコ$$.」

177:t_1:304.en:
$n
「I heard from $$シン$$ that you were in the $$連邦軍$$'s combat technique research team.」

177:t_1:305.en:
$n
「Please. I'm asking you to coach my piloting skills.」

177:t_1:306.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...Judging by the last battle, I thought you were fighting well enough...」

177:t_1:307.en:
$n
「Well enough isn't enough. I... I want to get stronger.」

177:t_1:308.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Improving your skills any further from here is harder than you can imagine.」

177:t_1:310.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Um... $$セツコ$$... Does $n still have room to improve?」

177:t_1:311.en:
$$セツコ$$
「From what I've seen, $n tends to be thrown around by his machine's performance.」

177:t_1:312.en:
$$セツコ$$
「For example, when there's a point he wants to stop at, $n either blows past it at high speed and forcibly corrects the gap with reverse thrusters...」

177:t_1:313.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Or he slows down more than necessary and squares it all up at the very end.」

177:t_1:314.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I get it! When I first became his partner, I was always getting motion sick!」

177:t_1:315.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm not as strong as Captain $$アムロ$$, but I'm a little confident in my precise piloting technique.」

177:t_1:316.en:
$$セツコ$$
「My superior drilled me hard on that.」

177:t_1:318.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you can keep up with the way 《$$グローリー・スター$$》 does things.」

177:t_1:320.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It's the team I used to belong to... And it's my pride, too.」

177:t_1:321.en:
$n
「Please, $$セツコ$$. I'll stake my own pride on this, too.」

177:t_1:322.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Well then, I'm going to go say hello to some old acquaintances, so let's discuss the training later.」

177:t_1:323.en:
$n
「...So that's $$セツコ・オハラ$$ of $$グローリー・スター$$...」

177:t_1:326.en:
$$宗介$$
「On $$翠の地球$$, we descended into the sea they call that.」

177:t_1:327.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's be accurate. We got attacked by the $$サイデリアル$$ on atmospheric entry, and it knocked our entry course way off... is what happened.」

177:t_1:328.en:
$$シン$$
「Still, I never thought $$ガロード$$ would be there.」
